_comment: Hand-written action JSON per server/schemas.py's ActionResponse shape ({action, targetId, value}), targeting the fixture at action_executor_page.html. targetId values assume the deterministic scan order documented and asserted in tests/unit/test_action_executor.test.mjs (username=agent-1, password=agent-2, login-btn=agent-3, disabled-btn=agent-4, forgot-link=agent-5, country-select=agent-6, custom-widget=agent-7). If that scan order ever changes, the test's own precondition assertion fails first and loudly, rather than this file going silently stale.
